details: Every contained cube gives an induced subgraph of matching minimum degree.
name: Degeneracy / Largest Strongly Shattered Set
proof: A strongly shattered set of size $d$ supplies a contained $d$-cube in the $1$-inclusion graph.  That cube is an induced subgraph of minimum degree $d$, so the graph degeneracy is at least $d$.
witness_verification: For ML_m, degeneracy is m+1 while the largest strongly shattered set has size 1.
